title: Reunion with Bill Coleman and the Moluccan crisis in Holland
summary: He stays with Coleman in France and finds himself in Holland during the Moluccan train hijacking.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: Uh-huh. Right, we talked -- mentioned that you didn't really do a lot of traveling.
It was rewarding. I got a chance to see my good friend, Bill Coleman, and stayed with him.
How long had it been since you'd seen Bill Coleman?
Oh, about 15 years. He came to visit and stayed with me, but -- had a nice time with him. He's one of the great musicians of our time.
Then we -- my wife and I, Liz, vacationed with some friends in Holland. And we were there when the Moluccans --
Oh, the Moluccans, yeah, they stopped the train.
And they were going to commandeer a 747 jet the day that we were supposed to leave at the same time. We didn't know whether we'd get back to America or not.
